description: Explicitly overrides the automatically analyzed assetClasses and dataRequirements metadata for this owned strategy revision only. Use this when the user asks for an override or the saved-code analysis needs a deliberate correction. Future revisions are analyzed fresh and do not inherit this override. This updates revision database metadata only; it does not edit strategy files.

assetClasses.description: Asset classes the strategy actually trades.

dataRequirements.description: Asset classes whose market data the strategy reads.

name: set_strategy_requirements
title: Set strategy asset and data requirements
